subject: Architecture deep-dive: ACME migration to Redwood
messages:
From: Catherine Taylor <ctaylor@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-11T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Architecture deep-dive: ACME migration to Redwood

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. ACME is ready to move from our current inference provider (dispatch.ai) and we want to run a focused architecture deep-dive to validate runtime compatibility, networking, and deployment for a PoC. Goal: establish a mutual action plan and confirm what we need for a week-long PoC.

Attendees on our side: myself (platform lead), Paul Kline (product owner), and Suresh Rao (security lead). We expect to cover: model formats and sizes, peak/inflight TPS, data residency/networking, and SOC2-related log retention.

Two-week window works for us. Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Aug 17, 10:00-11:00
- Wed Aug 18, 15:00-16:00
- Fri Aug 20, 09:00-10:00

Please let me know which slots work and who from Redwood will attend (SE/solutions, infra, and someone for security questions). Attaching our current infra diagram (redacted).

Thanks,
Catherine

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-11T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive: ACME migration to Redwood

Catherine — great to see this moving. Thanks for the diagram.

We can cover the items you listed. Rishi (solutions eng) and Dev (pre-sales infra) will join to run the technical deep-dive. To make the session efficient, can you confirm:
- expected model sizes (max tokens / params) or provide a representative model artifact
- current peak qps and expected concurrency for the PoC
- whether ACME wants a hosted Redwood API or a Private VPC PoC first

We can do Tue Aug 17 10:00-11:00 PST — that slot works for all of us. I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm attendees.

Proposed session outline (45 min tech + 30 min ops/next steps):
1) 10’ intros & PoC objectives
2) 20’ model/runtime compatibility and resource sizing
3) 15’ networking/KMS/SOC2 items
4) 30’ mutual action plan + follow-ups

Pre-read: I uploaded a short checklist and a Mutual Action Plan template to this folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ACME-DeepDive-PreRead

Attaching a filled MAP skeleton for scheduling/owners.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Catherine / Marissa — looking forward to the session Tuesday. A couple of quick asks to help us prepare the right runbook and sizing: 

1) Can you paste max sequence length and average response token count for the calls you expect during the PoC?
2) Peak concurrent requests (95th percentile) and typical request/response latency distribution (if available).
3) Any firewall/egress rules that would block egress to cloud storage or telemetry endpoints.

For the session itself, we'll plan: 45 minutes blue-team technical dive (model artifacts, KV/attention/cache behavior, memory footprint) + 30 minutes ops/runbook + 15 minutes Q&A. If you prefer longer ops time we can stretch, but this keeps the meeting tight.

I've attached a short pre-read runbook and a list of information we'd like to have accessible in the drive link earlier. If you can drop the model metadata and traffic trace there before EOD Monday that would be ideal.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
